body_lead: CtrlS plans ₹10,000 crore AI factory in Bihar, opens 12 MW Patna data centre The proposed 150 MW facility in Bodh Gaya forms part of CtrlS’ expansion plans, which include over 20 edge data centres across India’s Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. CtrlS Datacenters has signed a letter of intent (LoI) with the Bihar government to invest ₹10,000 crore in a proposed 150 MW hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya, while inaugurating a ₹400 crore data centre in Patna with an initial IT load capacity of 12 MW.
